title: The Problem with Jev: Can You Trust AI Decisions?
description:
Learn more about New Frontier AI Models here → https://ibm.biz/~QV9RAqelj

A confident AI decision isn't necessarily a trustworthy one. Jeff Crume examines Jev through a cybersecurity lens, from attack surfaces and poisoned inputs to observability and verification. Learn why AI decisions need evidence, auditability, and human oversight.

 00:00 – Question Whether AI Confidence Can Be Trusted
 00:26 – Understand the Problem with Jev
 01:47 – Compare Jev Decisions with LLM Outputs
 02:48 – Separate AI Confidence from Evidence
 03:37 – See How Jev Changes the AI Attack Surface
 05:54 – Build Observability Around AI Decisions
 07:00 – Break AI Decisions Into Verifiable Steps
 08:30 – Understand Why AI Predictions Are Hard to Verify
 10:38 – Secure Jev with Independent Controls
 11:29 – Verify AI Decisions Before You Trust Them
